name: doo-v13-autumn
description: smoketest_maps blizzard/(2)AutumnLeaves_S2_v2.0.w3x (war3map.doo version 8 / subversion 11 with skin ids, 6277 doodads, 55 specials) opened and saved after an empty edit: the editor's save writes the doodads file as version 13, subversion 11, the order and the specials kept, every doodad with preFlags 0xFFFFFFFF, editorId 0xFFFFFFFF and its creation number in trailer[0] (trailer [n, 0, 0]), no extras, its skin id kept; Studio's terrain-view save the same (lib/terrain/dooversion.ts, branch feat/doo-v13-upgrade): MATCH 2026-11-23.
